headline: Executive order on federal support for water quality improvements, with an emphasis on collaboration and oversight.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with how the federal government supports efforts to improve water quality. The title points to more collaboration, likely with states or other partners, and more oversight of how federal support is used. No summary or full text was provided, so the specific rules, programs, and deadlines are not known.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that fund or manage water quality programs
who_it_affects.how: The title suggests these agencies may face new direction on how they work with partners and oversee federal water quality support.

who_it_affects.group: State and local governments that receive federal water quality support
who_it_affects.how: They may see changes in how they work with federal agencies or how their use of federal support is reviewed, though details are not available.
